items.title: Pre-Release of Polars 2.0
items.blurb: Preview of Python Polars 2.0, bringing the streaming engine to all lazy queries

items.title: Amazon Quick adds new tool settings and Model Context Protocol (MCP) sync support for connectors
items.blurb: Amazon Quick connectors let users leverage tools and services such as Outlook, Slack, Salesforce, Jira, and homegrown MCP servers directly into their workflows across chat, agents, apps, flows, and deep research.

items.title: Web Search on Amazon Bedrock is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
items.blurb: The Web Search built-in server-side tool on Amazon Bedrock is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West), helping bring grounded web results to compliance-sensitive government and public-sector workloads.

items.title: Second-generation AWS Outposts racks now in the AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
items.blurb: Second-generation AWS Outposts racks are now supported in the AWS GovCloud (US-East) and AWS GovCloud (US-West) Regions.

items.title: AWS Config now supports 60 new resource types
items.blurb: AWS Config now supports 60 additional AWS resource types across key services including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon EC2, Amazon SageMaker, and AWS Organizations.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer expands automated performance evaluations to Malay
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now automates evaluations of human and AI agents in Malay using generative AI.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer announces general availability of agentic CX designer
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer announces the general availability of agentic CX designer, a no-code canvas for designing and deploying AI-powered self-service experiences.
